description: This file defines the base class 'Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter' for filter implementations in Ext JS, providing an abstract structure for creating various filter types for grids, including event handling, configuration, and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter
classes.description: An abstract base class for grid filters that defines common properties, event handling, and method templates for subclasses.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the filter by removing event listeners and destroying associated menus.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Template method for initializing the filter and installing menu items; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Template method to retrieve the current filter value; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Template method to set the filter value; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter can be activated; defaults to returning true.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Template method to serialize filter data for server communication.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the filter; defaults to always true.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns serialized filter data and fires the 'serialize' event.

methods.name: fireUpdate
methods.description: Fires 'update' event if filter is active, then reevaluates activation state.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the filter's active state and fires 'activate' or 'deactivate' events accordingly.
